title: When More Omics Is Not Always Better: Drug- and Dataset-Conditional Value of Multimodal Cancer Pharmacogenomics
description: Reproducibility release containing code, split manifests, derived result summaries, figures, manuscript materials, and environment specifications for a leakage-controlled multimodal cancer drug-response benchmark. Raw DepMap, GDSC, and CTD² provider files are excluded and must be obtained under their applicable terms.
